item.title: Version 2.7
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.7

  • Find duplicates. A new Duplicates list shows songs that are on your iPod more than once. The best copy (cover art, complete info, quality, plays) is marked Keep; Remove Extra Copies removes the rest and puts the kept copy in their playlists.
  • Your own cover art. In the Info panel, choose Choose Cover Art… or drop an image on the artwork. JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP and more; select a whole album to change it at once.
  • Fix Info searches more catalogues. When iTunes has no good match, Fix Info also tries Deezer and MusicBrainz, for English, Indian and other music. Each suggestion shows where it came from.
